unavailable.title: Map unavailable
unavailable.body: The map needs WebGL2. Update the graphics driver or restart VectaSim – recording keeps running.

toolbar.tilt: Tilt the map and show the track's altitude profile – online traffic appears as 3D models from zoom 8; also rotate and tilt with the right mouse button or Ctrl + drag
toolbar.globeOff: Flat world view (Mercator) instead of a globe – applies to every map
toolbar.globeOn: World view as a globe – zooming in turns it into the flat map by itself; applies to every map
toolbar.globeDormant: Globe is on and shows when you zoom out – from zoom {zoom} the map looks flat. Click to switch to the flat world view (Mercator).
toolbar.fullscreenTitle: Full screen: track map, profile and replay bar fill the window (F)

mapStyle.onTitle: Satellite imagery as the base map (Sentinel-2, cloud-free) – places, borders and our layers stay on top; applies to the map and the track map
mapStyle.offTitle: Back to the drawn map – applies to the map and the track map

weather.onTitle: Show weather: METAR category from zoom {zoom}, optionally precipitation radar and clouds – real weather, may differ from the sim's weather
weather.offTitle: Hide weather (METAR, radar, clouds) – radar and clouds are then no longer fetched
weather.menuTitle: Choose weather layers: METAR rings, precipitation radar, clouds
weather.metarTitle: Flight category (VFR/MVFR/IFR/LIFR) as a ring at the airports, from zoom {zoom}
weather.radarTitle: Precipitation radar from RainViewer, refreshed every 10 minutes – real weather, may differ from the sim's weather
weather.cloudsTitle: Clouds from the infrared satellite image (EUMETSAT, hourly) – the brighter, the higher and colder; real weather, may differ from the sim's weather
weather.note: Real weather – may differ from the weather in the simulator.

legend.aria: METAR colours: flight category at the airport
legend.vfr: VFR: ceiling above 3,000 ft and visibility above 5 SM (about 8 km)
legend.mvfr: MVFR: ceiling 1,000–3,000 ft or visibility 3–5 SM (about 5–8 km)
legend.ifr: IFR: ceiling 500–999 ft or visibility 1 to under 3 SM (about 1.6–5 km)
legend.lifr: LIFR: ceiling below 500 ft or visibility below 1 SM (about 1.6 km)
legend.unknown: ?: the METAR gives neither ceiling nor visibility

traffic.ivaoTitle: IVAO traffic and controllers only (aircraft outlined in the accent colour)
traffic.bothTitle: VATSIM and IVAO at the same time – IVAO aircraft outlined in the accent colour
traffic.offTitle: Hide online traffic ({network}) on the map – the network keeps being polled every 60 s in the background (switch it off in Settings → Online traffic)
traffic.offTitleBoth: Hide online traffic (VATSIM + IVAO) on the map – the networks keep being polled every 60 s in the background (switch them off in Settings → Online traffic)
traffic.onTitle: Online traffic: show aircraft and controllers from {network} (fetches the public feed)
traffic.onTitleBoth: Online traffic: show aircraft and controllers from VATSIM and IVAO (fetches the public feeds)
traffic.networkTitle: Choose network: VATSIM, IVAO or both

trafficCard.gone: no longer online – card closes in {seconds} s
trafficCard.noRulesAltitude: no flight rules or altitude given
trafficCard.heading: Heading
trafficCard.headingTitle: Heading: where the aircraft's nose points
trafficCard.squawkTitle: Transponder code assigned by air traffic control
trafficCard.fromYouTitle: Distance and direction from your own aircraft
trafficCard.flTitle: Flight level: altitude in hundreds of feet at standard pressure 1013 hPa
trafficCard.rulesChangeTitle: Flight rules change en route (IFR ↔ VFR)
trafficCard.rulesTitle: Flight rules from the flight plan
trafficCard.followingTitle: Camera follows this aircraft – click again or use “Follow” in the map bar for your own
trafficCard.routeTitle: Filed route on the map: waypoints from the running MSFS, an installed X-Plane or the bundled navaids; gaps as a dashed great circle
trafficCard.compass: N NNE NE ENE E ESE SE SSE S SSW SW WSW W WNW NW NNW

photo.off: no photo (aircraft photos are off in the settings)

markers.menuTitle: Choose which markers the flight path shows: gear, flaps, rotation, approach gates and criteria, touchdowns
markers.note: Labels from zoom {zoom}; click a marker to move the replay cursor there.

groupTitle.gear: Where the gear went down and up (more than half extended, held for 2 s)
groupTitle.flaps: Every flap handle change with height and speed
groupTitle.rotation: Lift-off with the rotation rate: mean pitch rate from rotation start to lift-off
groupTitle.gates: 1000 ft and 500 ft gate (stable or not), “stable from” and go-around – from the approach assessment
groupTitle.criteria: Stable-approach exceedances (speed, sink rate, glide path, course, bank, configuration, thrust, energy) as coloured stretches

detail.noRotation: no pitch-up run measurable on the take-off roll
detail.rotationTypical: Normal band 1.5–4 °/s, airliners typically 2–3 °/s; below is slow, above is fast
detail.stableFrom: from here down to 50 ft no criterion outside its tolerance
detail.click: Click: replay cursor to this moment
